r01.

There is no Redis connection or Redis-backed cache. The cache is an in-process, `sync.Map`-based `cache.Cache` (`store/cache/cache.go:66`), constructed for `userCache` by `store.New` (`store/store.go:37`, `store/store.go:52`). User entries use the shared default TTL of 10 minutes (`store/store.go:40`; applied by `Cache.Set` in `store/cache/cache.go:92`).
